article.title: Establishment of Central University in Andhra Pradesh
article.content:
371EEstablishment of Central University in Andhra Pradesh

Article 371E · Part XXI
Parliament may by law provide for the establishment of a University in the State of Andhra Pradesh.]

1 Art 371D and Art 371E ins. by the Constitution (Thirty-second Amendment) Act, 1973, s. 3 (w.e.f. 1-7-1974).
